newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady with crude, heavy barrels tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady with crude, heavy barrels tight.

text.p: NWE naphtha was stable on Friday as crude oil futures settled back to Thursday's levels but the market remains tight in northwest Europe with good demand for n+a material, traders said.
A Bilbao cargo was heard sold into northern France but the price was not known. A trader sold a Skikda cargo on Thursday to another trader at $3.75 over published cif Med quotes.
Supply in the Med for September seems to be lengthening with Egyptian barrels and Skikda emerging, but plentiful demand ensures support for prices.
